turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Marcus! How are things going? How has the school year been treating you now that you're a few weeks in?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! Things are going well, but it's definitely getting busy. I needed a lot of energy today, so I made sure to have some oatmeal for breakfast before heading out.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oatmeal is a great way to fuel up for a busy day of teaching chemistry. How are your classes shaping up this semester?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: They're good! The kids are energetic, though keeping them focused during lab safety briefings is always a challenge. I actually just got back from doing some tennis as my workout today, which helped blow off some steam.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oh, nice! A tennis session is perfect for clearing your head after a day of teaching. How did you play?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I played alright! Serves were a bit rusty, but my backhand was feeling solid. It was just nice to run around on the court.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's great to hear. Did Grace join you, or was she busy today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: She had some work things to finish up, so she couldn't make it this time. She's hoping we can play together this weekend, though.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I hope you two get a chance to play! How is the weather in Portland today? Good tennis weather?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's actually really nice today. Sunny but not too hot, which is perfect for being outside. I might try to get into the garage for some woodworking later this week if the weather holds up.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a wonderful way to spend an afternoon. Do you have a specific project you're working on right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Nothing too major, just cleaning up some old scrap pieces and planning a small shelf. It's nice to just work with my hands after a long day of teaching.
